strings.hub_kicker: There’s always something to look forward to
strings.hub_intro: Find the date. Count the days. Make a little room for anticipation.
strings.hub_description: Find holiday dates, weekdays, and live countdowns to Christmas, Halloween, Easter, New Year, and more.
strings.own_dates: Your own dates deserve a countdown, too.
strings.own_intro: Calculate your days together or explore more countdown ideas.
strings.holiday_description: {holiday}: {date}. See days and weeks remaining and dates for upcoming years.
strings.enable_countdown: Enable JavaScript to see the days remaining.
strings.app_title: Put your next big day on your Home Screen.
strings.app_body: Add your date in {app}, choose your colours, and keep the days remaining close with a widget.
strings.country_hint: Suggested from your browser settings. You can change it.
strings.easter_rule: A Sunday between 22 March and 25 April
strings.regional_about: The date shown follows this observance: {scope}.
strings.regional_note: Holiday dates vary by country. The observance shown on this page may differ from local celebrations.
strings.calculator_description: Calculate your days together, next anniversary, and upcoming day milestones.
strings.calculator_kicker: A little math. A lot of memories.
strings.calculator_intro: Every day is part of your story. Find out how many days you’ve been together and which milestone is coming next.
strings.start_intro: Your first date, wedding day, or any date worth remembering.
strings.as_of_hint: Today, or a date you’re planning for.
strings.calculator_loading: Enable JavaScript to use the calculator. If it’s already enabled, try refreshing this page.
strings.empty_body: Start with a date. We’ll find the days, anniversaries, and little reasons to celebrate.
strings.counting_note: We count full calendar days between dates. Your start date is day 0; the following date is day 1.
strings.milestone_title: Make your next milestone a daily reminder.
strings.milestone_body: Add your date in {app} for Home Screen widgets and anniversary reminders on your Apple devices.
strings.how_body: Enter your relationship’s start date or wedding date, then choose today or a future date. The calculator finds your days together, next yearly anniversary, and upcoming milestones. Weekends and leap days are included.
strings.example: 1 January 2025 to 1 January 2026 is 365 days. Your 1,000-day milestone is 28 September 2027.
strings.dating_body: Count the days since your first date or the day you made it official.
strings.wedding_body: Find how long you’ve been married and your next anniversary.
strings.personal_body: Mark a friendship, a new chapter, or another meaningful beginning.
strings.faq_days_q: How many days have we been together?
strings.faq_days_a: Enter your start date and use today as the calculation date. The result shows the calendar days between those dates, plus the duration in weeks and days.
strings.faq_first_q: Does the calculator include the first day?
strings.faq_first_a: The start date is day 0 and the next date is day 1. If you count your start date as day 1, add one to the total. All milestones use elapsed days.
strings.faq_leap_q: What if our anniversary is 29 February?
strings.faq_leap_a: Choose 28 February or 1 March for non-leap years. In leap years, the anniversary stays on 29 February. Your total always counts actual calendar days.
strings.faq_thousand_a: It is your start date plus 1,000 calendar days. The next three milestones are shown; passed milestones are replaced by upcoming ones.
strings.faq_wedding_q: Can I use this for a wedding anniversary?
strings.faq_wedding_a: Yes. Use your wedding date, first date, friendship anniversary, or work anniversary as the start date.
strings.faq_app_a: No. The calculator works here without an account. Dates are calculated in your browser and are not sent to a server. Add your date separately in the app for widgets and reminders.
strings.error_dates: Enter valid dates between years 0001 and 9998.
strings.error_order: The calculation date must be on or after your start date.
strings.days_title: Days until & days between dates calculator
strings.days_description: Count the days until any date or between two dates. See the total in weeks, months, and weekdays, with quick countdowns to Christmas and New Year.
strings.days_kicker: How long until the big day?
strings.days_intro: Find out how many days are left until a trip, a deadline, or a celebration, or how many days lie between any two dates.
strings.days_form_intro: Start from today, or choose any two dates.
strings.days_empty_body: Choose an end date to see the days in between, plus weeks, months, and weekdays.
strings.days_same: Both dates are the same day.
strings.days_counting_note: We count calendar days. The start date counts and the end date doesn’t, so tomorrow is 1 day away. Include the end date to add one day.
strings.days_app_title: Watch the days tick down on your Home Screen.
strings.days_app_body: Add your date in {app} for a countdown widget and reminders on your iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch.
strings.days_how_title: How to count the days between two dates
strings.days_how_body: Choose a start date, which is today unless you change it, and an end date. The calculator counts the calendar days between them and shows the same span in weeks, calendar months, and weekdays. Results update as soon as both dates are set.
strings.days_example: 1 January 2026 to 25 December 2026 is 358 days: 51 weeks and 1 day, or 11 months and 24 days.
strings.days_trips_body: See how long until a holiday, a concert, a wedding, or the next big match.
strings.days_deadlines_body: Know how many days and weekdays are left before a due date.
strings.days_celebrations_body: Find the days until a birthday, Christmas, or New Year’s Day.
strings.days_faq_until_q: How many days until a date?
strings.days_faq_until_a: Keep today as the start date and choose the date you’re waiting for. The result shows the days left, plus the same span in weeks, months, and weekdays.
strings.days_faq_end_q: Does the count include the end date?
strings.days_faq_end_a: Not by default. The start date counts and the end date doesn’t, so tomorrow is 1 day away. Turn on “Include the end date” to count both dates, which adds one day.
strings.days_faq_weekdays_a: Weekdays are the days in the span that aren’t weekend days, usually Monday to Friday. Bank holidays aren’t removed, so the result can differ from official working days.
strings.days_faq_past_q: Can I count the days since a past date?
strings.days_faq_past_a: Yes. Choose an end date in the past, or move the start date back. The calculator shows how many days lie between the two dates in either direction.
strings.days_faq_app_a: No. The calculator works here without an account, and your dates stay in your browser. To keep a countdown on your Home Screen, add the date in {app}.

christmas.name: Christmas
christmas.intro: The big day, the weekday, and the days left to get ready. Count down to Christmas morning wherever you are.
christmas.explanation_title: Same date. A different day of the week.
christmas.explanation: This countdown follows Christmas Day on 25 December in the Gregorian calendar. The date stays the same each year, while the weekday changes. Christmas Eve is 24 December.
christmas.scope_note: Some Christian communities celebrate Christmas on a different date. This page tracks the 25 December observance, rather than an employer’s observed day off.
christmas.planning: Make separate countdowns for your last shopping day, your journey home, and Christmas dinner. Each can have its own reminder in the app.

halloween.name: Halloween
halloween.intro: Costumes to plan. Pumpkins to pick. See which day Halloween falls on and how long you have to get ready.
halloween.explanation: Halloween’s calendar date stays the same each year, but its weekday changes. Use the upcoming dates to see whether the next Halloween falls during the week or on a weekend.
halloween.scope_note: Local trick-or-treat hours, school celebrations, and Halloween parties may use different dates or times. Check the organiser’s schedule for your plans.
halloween.planning: Count down to 31 October, then add your own costume deadline or party date. Keep the one you’re most excited about on your Home Screen.

new-year.name: New Year
new-year.intro: Look ahead to 1 January. See the next New Year’s date and count the days to a brand-new chapter.
new-year.explanation_title: A new year starts on 1 January.
new-year.explanation: This page follows the Gregorian calendar. New Year’s Eve is 31 December, and New Year’s Day begins at midnight immediately afterward. That moment arrives at different times around the world.
new-year.scope_note: The countdown uses your device’s local calendar date. It does not follow the midnight celebration in a particular city or the dates of Lunar New Year and other calendars.
new-year.planning: Add your New Year’s Eve party as its own event with a start time. Use another countdown for a January trip, a personal goal, or the first day of something new.

thanksgiving.name: Thanksgiving
thanksgiving.intro: Start with the date. Make room for the plans. Count the days until Thanksgiving in the United States.
thanksgiving.explanation: US Thanksgiving falls on the fourth Thursday in November. Because November begins on a different weekday from year to year, Thanksgiving’s date ranges from 22 November to 28 November. It is not always the last Thursday of the month.
thanksgiving.scope_note: This page is for US Thanksgiving. Canadian Thanksgiving follows a different calendar rule and is not the date shown here.
thanksgiving.planning: Give your travel day, grocery shopping, and family meal their own countdowns. A reminder before each date can help spread the preparation across the week.

easter.name: Easter
easter.intro: Find the next Easter Sunday, see future dates, and count the days until your spring celebration.
easter.explanation_title: Why is Easter on a different date each year?
easter.explanation: Western Easter uses a church calendar calculation involving an ecclesiastical full moon and a fixed 21 March equinox. It falls on a Sunday between 22 March and 25 April. The calculation uses calendar rules rather than the exact full moon visible from your location.
easter.scope_note: This page shows Western Christian Easter in the Gregorian calendar. Orthodox Easter may fall on a different Sunday. School breaks and public holidays also vary by location.
easter.planning: Keep Easter Sunday separate from your school break, travel dates, and family gathering. Add the dates your school or organiser confirms to the app.

valentines-day.name: Valentine’s Day
valentines-day.intro: A small surprise or a big night out. Find the date and count the days until Valentine’s Day.
valentines-day.explanation_title: 14 February, whichever weekday it falls on.
valentines-day.explanation: Valentine’s Day is celebrated on 14 February each year. The weekday changes, so the table below can help you plan a meal, a trip, or time together.
valentines-day.scope_note: This page follows the 14 February celebration. If you celebrate on a nearby weekend or another date, create a separate countdown for those plans.
valentines-day.planning: Add a reminder for your reservation or gift, then keep your celebration date on a widget. You can also count up from the day your own story began.

mothers-day.name: Mother’s Day
mothers-day.intro: See when Mother’s Day falls in the United States and how many days are left to make your plans.
mothers-day.explanation: In the United States, Mother’s Day falls on the second Sunday of May. Its date can range from 8 May to 14 May, so it moves on the calendar while staying on a Sunday.
mothers-day.scope_note: Mother’s Day dates vary by country. This is the US date; it should not be used for the UK’s Mothering Sunday or assumed to apply everywhere.
mothers-day.planning: Plan a visit, a call, or time together. Add a separate reminder for sending a card or arranging flowers so the preparation has its own place on your calendar.

fathers-day.name: Father’s Day
fathers-day.kicker: Make time for a good day together
fathers-day.intro: Find the US Father’s Day date and count the days until a visit, a meal, or a simple moment together.
fathers-day.explanation: In the United States, Father’s Day falls on the third Sunday of June. Its date ranges from 15 June to 21 June, while the day of the week remains Sunday.
fathers-day.scope_note: Father’s Day is observed on other dates in some countries. This page tracks the US observance, so check the local date if you are planning a celebration elsewhere.
fathers-day.planning: Add your celebration and any preparation dates separately. A countdown to a visit or a shared activity can be a nice reminder of what’s coming up.
